notes.title: Celebrate the Ukrainian Games Festival with 40% off DFA until August 25th!
notes.content:
Attention troops! [b]Death From Above[/b] will be participating in the [b]Ukrainian Games Festival[/b] on Steam, starting today, [b]August 19th until August 25th[/b], with a [b]40% discount[/b] on DFA and all of our DLC!

The UGF celebrates Ukrainian Independence Day (August 24th) with a showcase of Ukrainian games here on Steam. We’re honored to be participating in this event again after our debut last year, and our support for the defense of Ukraine against Russian aggression is undimmed. 

This month we will also make our second donation to our Ukrainian charity partners, sending 4218 Eur to Come Back Alive and Aerorozvidka. We continue with our commitment to sending 30% of all proceeds from Death From Above to charity, up until the point where development costs are covered, where we will switch to donating 70% of our proceeds instead. 

We believe that games can change the world, and that change starts with you. 

Slava Ukraini!


[b]Small update also launching today[/b]

We’ve also pushed a small patch this morning with a few updates - details below!

[list]
[*] Updated NVIDIA DLSS from 3.1 to 3.7!

We have added [b]Slovak[/b], [b]Lithuanian[/b], and [b]Czech[/b] to our in-game languages. However, we need your assistance to improve the quality and accuracy of these translations.

notes.title: Lietuviška mūsų Steam puslapio versija
notes.content:
"Death From Above" žingsniuokite už priešo linijų kaip Ukrainos kariuomenės dronų operatorius. Valdykite universalius dronus, išvalykite teritorijas nuo įsibrovėlių, deminuokite zonas, perimkite aprūpinimo konvojus ir tyrinėkite smėlio dėžės žemėlapį su tonomis paslėptų Velykinių kiaušinių. Kovokite už geresnį rytojų! Slava Ukraini!

[b]"Death From Above"[/b] pateikia glaustą, vieno žaidėjo arkadinę drono patirtį, kurios veiksmas vyksta Rusijos invazijos į Ukrainą fone. Įsijaukite į Ukrainos kariuomenės drono operatoriaus vaidmenį, kovokite su priešo pajėgomis, atgaukite pavogtą įrangą ir taisykite karo nutrauktas gyvybiškai svarbias ryšių linijas.

[b]"Death From Above"[/b] yra daugiau nei tik žaidimas; tai galimybė padaryti realų poveikį! 30% mūsų grynojo pelno tiesiogiai remia dvi Ukrainos organizacijas, "Come Back Alive" ir "Army of Drones", skatinančias neofensyvią pagalbą Ukrainos ginkluotosioms pajėgoms. Taip jūs galite jaustis užtikrinti, kad jūsų pirkimas prisideda prie vertingo tikslo. Kai tik padengsime žaidimo gamybos išlaidas, padidinsime mūsų indėlį, skirdami 70% mūsų grynojo pajamų šioms geroms priežastims. Likę 30% bus investuoti į tolesnį žaidimo vystymą.

[h2]Pagrindinės savybės:[/h2]

[b]Dinamiškas žaidimo režimo perjungimas:[/b] 
Sklandžiai perjunkite tarp operatoriaus, universalaus keturkampio drono ir įtraukiančio FPV (Pirmojo asmens vaizdo) drono vaidmenų, priklausomai nuo situacijos. Šis dinamiškas žaidimas siūlo įvairias patirtis ir iššūkius, išlaikydamas žaidėjų susidomėjimą ir verčia juos būti budriais.

[b]Įvairūs misijų tikslai:[/b] 
Nuo minų šalinimo ir zonų valymo nuo priešų iki priešo konvojų sulaikymo ir sustabdymo, kiekviena misija atneša savo iššūkių rinkinį.

[b]Turtinga smėlio dėžės aplinka:[/b] 
Tyrinėkite žemėlapį, pilną smėlio dėžės su daugybe paslėptų Velykinių kiaušinių, kurie remiasi tikrais įvykiais iš fizinio ir virtualaus mūšio laukų Ukrainoje. Šie paslėpti brangakmeniai ne tik suteikia lengvą atsipalaidavimą, bet ir praturtina žaidimo pasaulį, todėl tyrinėjimas tampa tiek smagus, tiek atlyginantis.

"Death From Above" žymi drąsų Lesser Evil prekės ženklo debiutą. Mes nusprendėme atkreipti dėmesį į spaudžiantį klausimą, kuris veikia milijonus Ukrainoje ir už jos ribų, poziciją, kurią kai kurie gali laikyti provokuojančia. Mūsų tikslas nėra sukelti ginčų dėl ginčų – tai prasmingas dialogas. Mes tikime žaidimų kaip aktyvizmo ir pokyčių platformos transformacine galia. Per šį žaidimą mes sustipriname mūsų nepalaužiamą palaikymą Ukrainos gynybai, taip pat suteikiame žaidėjams visame pasaulyje galimybę paremti teisingą kovą!

Ar esate pasiruošę stoti į Ukrainos pusę ir žaisti "Death From Above"?
Prisijunkite prie mūsų, pakelkite žaidimą į aukštesnį lygį ir stovėkite virtualioje solidarumoje už Ukrainos laisvę. Jūsų palaikymas daro skirtumą.

notes.title: Slovenská verzia našej Steam stránky
notes.content:
V "Death From Above" sa postavte za nepriateľské línie ako operátor vojenských dronov z Ukrajiny. Ovládajte univerzálne drony, vyčistite oblasti od útočníkov, odmínovávajte zóny, prestrihávajte zásobovacie konvoje a preskúmajte sandboxovú mapu s množstvom skrytých veľkonočných vajíčok. Bojujte za lepšiu budúcnosť! Sláva Ukrajine!

[b]"Death From Above"[/b] prináša stručný, jednohráčový arkádový zážitok s dronmi na pozadí ruskej invázie na Ukrajinu. Vstúpte do úlohy operátora ukrajinských vojenských dronov, bojujte proti nepriateľským silám, získavajte späť ukradnuté vybavenie a opravujte životne dôležité komunikačné linky, ktoré boli poškodené vojnou.

[b]"Death From Above"[/b] je viac než len hra; je to šanca mať skutočný dopad na reálny svet! 30% z našich čistých výnosov priamo podporuje dve ukrajinské organizácie, "Come Back Alive" a "Army of Drones", ktoré zastávajú neofenzívnu pomoc Ozbrojeným silám Ukrajiny. Takto môžete mať istotu, že váš nákup prispieva na hodnú vec. Keď sa nám podarí dosiahnuť bod zlomu v produkcií hry, zvýšime náš príspevok, posielajúc 70% z našich čistých príjmov týmto dobrým príčinam. Zvyšných 30% bude investovaných do ďalšieho rozvoja hry.

[h2]Kľúčové vlastnosti:[/h2]

[b]Dynamické prepínanie hry:[/b] 
Plynule prepínajte medzi úlohami operátora, všestranného kvadrokoptéry a pohlcujúceho dronu s FPV (First Person View), podľa potreby situácie. Táto dynamická hrateľnosť ponúka rôznorodé zážitky a výzvy, ktoré udržujú hráčov zapojených a v strehu.

[b]Rôznorodé ciele misií:[/b] 
Od odmínovania a čistenia zón od protivníkov po zachytávanie a zastavenie nepriateľských konvojov, každá misia prináša vlastnú sadu výziev.

[b]Bohaté sandboxové prostredie:[/b] 
Preskúmajte mapu plnú sandboxu s množstvom skrytých veľkonočných vajíčok, ktoré odkazujú na skutočné udalosti z fyzických a virtuálnych bojísk na Ukrajine. Tieto skryté poklady nielenže poskytujú ľahkú úľavu, ale tiež obohacujú herný svet, čo robí prieskum zábavným a odmeňujúcim.

"Death From Above" označuje odvážny debut značky Lesser Evil. Rozhodli sme sa upriamiť pozornosť na naliehavý problém, ktorý ovplyvňuje milióny ľudí na Ukrajine a ďalej, postoj, ktorý niektorí môžu považovať za provokatívny. Naším cieľom nie je kontroverzia pre samotnú kontroverziu - je to zmysluplný dialóg. Veríme v transformačnú silu hier ako platformy pre aktivizmus a zmenu. Prostredníctvom tejto hry zosilňujeme našu neochvejnú podporu obrane Ukrajiny, ako aj dávame hráčom po celom svete šancu podporiť spravodlivú vec!

Ste pripravení postaviť sa po bok Ukrajiny a hrať "Death From Above"?
Pridajte sa k nám, povzneste hru a postavte sa vo virtuálnej solidarite za slobodu Ukrajiny. Vaša podpora robí rozdiel.

notes.title: Death From Above 1.0 Release
notes.content:
It’s been a long march, but we’ve reached our objective: launch day!

We’re proud of the journey we’ve made, and will continue to make, as we raise funds for our charity partners in Ukraine. After 10 months in Early Access, today is the day we make version 1.0 available!

[previewyoutube=XxyMtheWtRY;full][/previewyoutube]
 
We want to thank you for your support and your feedback, for everything you have done to spread the word and make Death From Above a success. For everyone who backed us on Kickstarter or bought the game in Early Access - we salute you. For everyone who is buying the game now, welcome to the front! 

For the 1.0 Full Release, we’ve added:

[list]
[*] New Achievements
[*] New Easter eggs
[*] New missions
[*] Completed storyline
[*] Outro + finale
[*] New Game+ mode
[*] Slovak, Czech and Lithuanian translations
[*] Bonus OST track
[/list]

The game has changed so much since we first hit Early Access last year, and we've created something very special - something that can make a real positive difference to real people's lives. 

But we're not just celebrating the release. In two days, we’ll commemorate another date. February 24th, 2024, is the second anniversary of open warfare in Ukraine. Two years of incessant shelling, two years of atrocities, two years of innocent civilians dying every single day. 

We must not falter in our opposition to Putin’s aggression. Now, more than ever, the people of Ukraine need our support. Take heart, friends. The night is darkest just before the dawn!

notes.title: New Mission, New Drone, New Languages!!
notes.content:
Greetings fellow freedom fighters! We've got an explosive new update for you - "Missile Rush" is locked and loaded with a deadly new FPV drone, additional languages, and more.

Strap in for a high speed ride with the new FPV Kamikaze Drone. Capable of speeds up to 120km/h, this lightning fast flyer can annihilate enemy vehicles with a single strike. Use it to blitz through the new Missile Rush mission, where you'll need to demolish missile launchers before the enemy can fire on civilians. The Missile Rush mission is a new step leading into the revamped narrative arc we've been working on!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43753697/528d7f78b00202a0a74a44bb10786fbe03986f26.gif[/img]

We've also added Georgian and Turkish language options so more comrades can join the fight. Existing languages like Japanese have received fixes and polish too.

Audio has been cranked up with improvements across the board and new sound effects to heighten the action. And as always, we've squeezed out some more performance optimizations.

Full patch notes:

[list]
New languages!
- Georgian
- Turkish
Fixes for Japanese language
Added a new drone type: FPV kamikaze drone!
- Up to 120km/h speed
- Can destroy a tank with one hit
A new mission: Missile Rush
- Use your new FPV kamikaze drone to destroy enemy missile launchers before they launch their missiles
Improvements to audio and new sound effects
Small performance optimizations
[/list]

The future of freedom calls, soldiers! Update now and take flight with our new kamikaze drone - the skies won't know what hit them. Glory to Ukraine!

notes.title: For our freedom and yours! New free update to DfA arrives on Steam today!
notes.content:
[b]Welcome soldiers[/b] - we have some new recruits for you to meet in our latest free content update named “For our freedom and yours”! We've begun our work on the mission structure to streamline the narrative, fixed some bugs, inevitably added some new ones and generally sprinkled joy over the game, we think you’re going to like it.

The biggest news this week, however, is that we’re joined on the battlefield by two very special new units: the [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kastu%C5%9B_Kalino%C5%ADski_Regiment]Kastuś Kalinoŭski Regiment[/url] from Belarus and [url=https://legionypolskie.eu/]The Polish Legion[/url] - both formed by volunteer soldiers from Ukraine’s neighbors. 

These units are putting everything on the line for the freedom of Ukraine, risking their lives as they fight alongside the troops of the Ukrainian armed forces to liberate their neighbors from Russian oppression. 

Tens of thousands of Ukrainians are on the front lines every day of course, but it’s a very special sort of soldier who will take up arms and defend the sovereignty, freedom and self-determination of another nation. We wanted to recognise that heroism by featuring skins from each unit for both your operator and drone in game. Additionally, both the game and the Steam page are now fully translated into Polish and Belarusian!

[b]Kastuś Kalinoŭski Battalion[/b]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43753697/dcc0aeb538b6b6d9f8f83257aa9e7841d029fd21.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43753697/e56396c2d4e8b4c733b73635ad7ffea1b60d14db.png[/img][/url]

This unit of Belarusian volunteers, opposed to the reign of president Alexander Lukashenko, comprises around 1500 soldiers and was formed specifically to defend Ukraine against Russian aggression in 2022. The battalion is named after Kastuś Kalinoŭski, one of the leaders of the 1863 January Uprising against the Russian Empire.

Formally admitted into the Ukrainian Ground Forces under oath in 2022, the unit participated in the liberation of Irpin in the Kyiv oblast. The Battalion has not limited its objectives to the freedom of Ukraine. With the motto ‘First Ukraine, then Belarus’, unit commanders have made clear that they intend to free their homeland from Putin’s influence via Lukashenko too, telling Belarusian citizens to “Wait for the signal” to begin the operation to free Belarus.

[b]The Polish Legion[/b]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43753697/29e1286e3c8fa2313a99767ffc1e82ec35cde86f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43753697/038e4ebe4a3940cf2bc6283e7f72ea294b4183cf.png[/img][/url]

A more recent addition to the Ukrainian forces, the Polish Legion is formed from Polish nationals who have volunteered for the conflict. The Polish Legion is an organization uniting Polish volunteers and volunteers from other countries who defend Ukraine, Poland, and Europe against the Russian invasion. The Legion's goal is to support Ukraine in its heroic struggle against the Russian aggressor, drawing upon our shared history.  

Currently, the Legion has three divisions - Support, Combat, and Cooperation. They engage not only in active combat assistance but also in humanitarian aid. They facilitate cooperation between the Ukrainian side and foreign companies, provide innovative AI equipment and drones, establish a Training Center for Operators, and support other Polish organizations. 

We’ve also made several changes to various missions and mechanics, as well as some quality-of-life improvements. See the full list of patch notes below.


[h2]Full patch notes[/h2]

[b]A bigger 1st and 2nd mission update that brings some level changes[/b]:
- New starting location

- Destroying a convoy in the 2nd mission
- New tower design

[b]New skins for the drone and operator![/b]
- Polish Legion skin on drone and operator
- Kastuś Kalinouski regiment skin on drone and operator
[b]New secrets[/b]
- You can find a russian drone somewhere on the map
- There's a suspicious outhouse somewhere
- New posters can be found for example in the starting village
[b]Optimizations to:[/b]
- Particle effects
- Grenade dropping
Language updates!

- Belarussian localization
[b]Intro cinematic can be replayed from the main menu
Various bug fixes[/b]

[b]Gamepad/controller mappings changed[/b]

notes.title: Meet the Devs! Joni and Alex
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43753697/8b411876bbe500cb09abbf03dbc3ba1c124ded8c.png[/img][h2]Meet the Devs![/h2]

Hello Everyone! 
We want to let you get to know the dev team a bit more, so we asked [b]Joni of [url=https://www.rockodilegames.com/]Rockodile Games[/url][/b] and [b]Alex of [url=https://octobearknight.games/]Octobear Knight Games[/url][/b], a few questions about their personal motivations for making [b]Death From Above[/b] and what the plans are for the game in the longer term.


[h3]What motivated you personally to make a game in support of the defense of Ukraine?[/h3]

[b]Joni:[/b] Raising funds and awareness for Ukraine are my main motivations. With [b]DfA[/b] we get to do something meaningful.

[b]Alex: [/b]My personal motivation is deeply rooted in my connection to Ukraine. Working on projects which are not related to the support of Ukraine is challenging for me at the moment. "Death from Above" serves as an important statement, compelling players to take a side and debunking the myth of the invincible Russian army.

[h3]Making a game about an ongoing conflict might be seen as a controversial decision - how do you see [b]DfA[/b] helping the cause?[/h3]
[b]
Joni:[/b] It is a sensitive subject, but our intentions are to help Ukraine and I’d rather help right now. Death from Above donates most of its revenue to charities helping Ukraine and raises awareness of the war started by Russia.

[b]Alex:[/b] I don't find creating a game about an ongoing war to be controversial. It is undoubtedly challenging, particularly when addressing war crimes and atrocities - striking a balance between sensitivity towards victims and acknowledging the reality of the situation can be tough.
 
[h3]Is Rockodile making a profit from the game? How will this work?[/h3]

[b]Joni:[/b] The development thus far has been funded by us and our publisher Lesser Evil and after we have covered our own costs we will be donating 70% of the games’ sales to charities supporting Ukraine. The remaining 30% will be used to further develop the game and to involve even more Ukrainian developers and artists in the development of the game in the future.

[h3]What plans do you have to improve the game once it’s on Early Access?[/h3]

[b]Alex:[/b] During Early Access, we plan to enhance "Death from Above" by extending the narrative, introducing more ways for players to interact with the world, and adding new enemies, including more common types and unique bosses. We may also borrow some randomization elements from the “roguelite” genre based on user feedback, but that’s still to be determined.


This was only a glimpse at two of our main devs, but you can check out their full Q&As on our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/hendriklesser/death-from-above]Kickstarter page's[/url] updates section!

Have a great weekend,
The Death From Above team
